nutrition.title: Edit Strategy
nutrition.subtitle: Macro targets that translate the Energy strategy into daily nutrition.
validation: Body-weight ratio: 0.5–2.0 g per lb, step 0.1 in Native.
Fixed protein: 50–400 g, step 5 in Native.
Carbohydrate and fat values must belong to the exact server allowlists.
Unchanged save is an idempotent unchanged success.
nutrition.error: This strategy was not saved. Refresh before retrying.

training.title: Edit Strategy
training.subtitle: Weekly structure and progression intent for the current phase.
validation: Each area must be a whole number from 0 to 7.
Total weekly area sessions must be at least 1.
At least one prioritized muscle group is required.
Progression must belong to conservative, moderate or aggressive.
Unchanged save is an idempotent unchanged success.
training.error: This strategy was not saved. Refresh before retrying.

mutationSemantics.cancel: Cancel dismisses and discards the local draft; there is no unsaved-change confirmation.
mutationSemantics.effectiveDate: Server stamps the successor with the current America/Los_Angeles local date; the date is not user-editable.
mutationSemantics.goalOwnership: Server carries the active protocol's currentGoalIds[0] or relatedGoalIds[0] as a supports relationship; Goal is not user-editable here.
mutationSemantics.phaseOwnership: Training preserves hidden phase/context fields; neither editor exposes a phase selector.
mutationSemantics.save: One direct Save Strategy action sends expectedCurrentVersionId. No second confirmation step.
mutationSemantics.success: Updated or unchanged success dismisses the editor back to strategy detail; there is no separate success page or toast.
mutationSemantics.failure: Native retains the draft and renders the generic editor error; stale/invalid/persistence details remain Server-owned.
mutationSemantics.history: A valid update appends a canonical successor, supersedes and ends the previous version at the successor effective date, advances currentVersionId, and preserves historical date resolution.
